explication: uv is a Rust-based Python package and project manager. The principal workflow starts at its CLI, resolves project or requirements inputs, obtains package metadata and distributions, then installs them into a managed environment; projects can also persist resolutions in a universal lockfile. Separate command branches support pip compatibility, scripts and tools, Python-version management, building/publishing, and auditing. The graph follows documented capabilities and crate responsibilities; sampled implementation excerpts are limited, so uncertain internal call wiring is omitted.
